data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 (ended January 26, 2025) total assets were about $111.6 billion. Amazon's balance sheet at the closest comparable date, December 31, 2024 (its fiscal 2024), showed about $624.9 billion. On that basis Amazon is roughly 5.6 times larger. Amazon's own fiscal 2025 year-end (December 31, 2025) total is not a figure I can state with confidence, and I haven't checked it against the 10-K. It would be higher than $624.9 billion, so the multiple would be larger than 5.6 times if you compare it with NVIDIA's $111.6 billion. For an exact fiscal-2025-to-fiscal-2025 ratio, confirm Amazon's figure in its 10-K filed in early 2026.
